zh-CN.title: 气泡预览换上真实影像
items: 图片预览改用高分辨率实景照片
视频预览加入真实封面、电影化取景、播放标识和时长
预览媒体完全使用本地资源，不会触发无效网络请求

en.title: Real imagery in bubble previews
items: Image previews now use a high-resolution photographic scene
Video previews now include a real poster, cinematic crop, play mark, and duration
Preview media is fully local and no longer triggers invalid network requests
